board.name: Board of Secondary Education, Andhra Pradesh (BSEAP) and Board of Intermediate Education, Andhra Pradesh (BIEAP)
board.summary: The Board of Secondary Education, Andhra Pradesh, working through the Directorate of Government Examinations, conducts the SSC public examinations at the end of Class 10 and the advanced supplementary (ASE) examinations that follow; its site lists the March 2026 public examinations and the May 2026 ASE. It publishes model question papers, blueprints and weightage tables, including those for the SSC public examination 2027. Intermediate is under the Board of Intermediate Education, Andhra Pradesh (bie.ap.gov.in).

intro: NXTutors has no city tuition-jobs page in Andhra Pradesh yet, so tutors in Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Guntur, Nellore, Tirupati and every other town join from this page. Give your town and the localities you can reach. Home lessons are matched by distance: the closest suitable tutors are offered a family's request first, then the search widens. Online lessons are matched by subject, class and board instead, so a tutor in Kakinada or Kurnool can teach a student in another state without leaving home. Coastal and inland towns alike can be listed, from Srikakulam in the north to Anantapur further south.

Andhra Pradesh students may take the SSC through BSEAP and Intermediate through BIEAP, or follow CBSE, ICSE or another board, in Telugu or English medium. List each board and medium on your profile. BSEAP publishes model question papers, blueprints and weightage tables for the 2027 SSC examination on its site, which are worth reading before a demo. Every request ends with two or three tutors and their fees; the first class is a free demo, and families can switch later. If you teach Intermediate, name the subjects and say whether your students are in the first or second year.

faqs: Where are the SSC 2027 model papers?

BSEAP has published model question papers, blueprints and weightage tables for the SSC public examination 2027 on bse.ap.gov.in. Reading them helps you answer a parent's questions about the paper in a demo.
Is Intermediate under the same board?
No. The Board of Intermediate Education, Andhra Pradesh, handles Intermediate. If you teach those classes, list the subjects and medium so a matching request can reach you.
For each request NXTutors picks two or three tutors, nearest first, then wider and online. The parent sees every fee, has a free first class, and can switch later without paying for it.
What does the ID check cover?
Your phone or email, confirmed by one-time code, and a government photo ID that the team reviews before the profile goes live. It is not a police or background check; see How we verify tutors.
Yes, tutor plans are paid, and /pricing lists what each includes. Your fee per lesson is your own decision.
